notes.subject: יספת לגוי
notes.rationale: Repetition of 'yu bin kirapim namba bilong ol lain manmeri' — Hebrew repeats for emphasis, kept in full.

notes.subject: רחקת כל קצוי ארץ
notes.rationale: 'Removed all ends of the earth' (KJV/ylt) vs 'enlarged all borders' (geneva/asv/bsb); this rendering follows the 'borders go far away' reading.

notes.subject: ol lain manmeri
notes.rationale: Verse counts the growth of the nation's numbers — an act of measuring increase.

translation: Yu bin kirapim namba bilong ol lain manmeri, Yahwe; yu bin kirapim namba bilong ol lain manmeri; yu bin kamapim nem bilong yu; yu bin wokim olgeta kona bilong graun i go longwe olgeta.

tokens.gloss: yu bin kamapim nem bilong yu
yu bin wokim … i go longwe olgeta
